findings.note: Eddins is on the sponsor list of HB 825, Election Improvements (filed 2025-04-09; primary sponsors are two other members; the bill was referred to House Rules and shows no further action on the member page). The bill text, read from the official PDF, would change what a voter must give when asking for an absentee ballot: the last four digits of the Social Security number plus one of a driver license number, a special ID card number, or a date of birth. It would also let voters without a photocopy of ID complete a reasonable-impediment affidavit with the same details. It also bans ranked choice voting, adjusts the area for election activity near polls, and shortens early voting.
